name: halftime
description: When you hit a Claude usage limit, take a short course on what Claude just did in your project: a briefing, lessons on its real topics, quizzes and a badge.

autoOpen.title: Open Halftime when you hit a usage limit
autoOpen.description: Off: Halftime stays quiet until you type /halftime.

prebake.title: Write the course without asking
prebake.description: Off by default: near a limit, Halftime asks once above your prompt (Prepare, Always or Not now) before its one small request. On: it writes the course without asking, once per limit window.

prebakeAt.title: Ask at this percent of your limit
prebakeAt.description: The percent of a limit window at which Halftime asks to write the course (or writes it, if prebake is on). It never asks above 95%.

autoContinue.title: Continue Claude's work when the limit resets
autoContinue.description: Only if Claude Code has not already continued by itself, and never if you turned off Continue automatically at usage limit in /config.

minWaitMinutes.title: Open only when the wait is at least this many minutes
minWaitMinutes.description: Shorter waits only show the countdown in the status line.

model.title: Model that writes the course
model.description: haiku (default, the lightest model: about a twentieth of the cost of sonnet) or sonnet.
